summary: xAI announced that Grok 4.5 is now available as a selectable model in GitHub Copilot (VSCode, cloud agents, CLI) and directly via the SpaceXAI API console at stated pricing.

mechanisms.reason: Distribution of the model into a mainstream developer tool used by millions expands the surface generating inference calls.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot for millions of developers who use VSCode and GitHub products every day.

categories.reason: The announcement is fundamentally about distribution of a frontier model through a major developer platform (GitHub Copilot).
categories.quote: Grok 4.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot for millions of developers who use VSCode and GitHub products every day.

practices.reason: The document asserts Grok 4.5 is the lab's smartest coding model but gives no specifics or benchmarks here, pointing elsewhere for detail.
practices.quote: Grok 4.5, our smartest coding model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.

practices.reason: Teams using GitHub Copilot can now select Grok 4.5 from the model picker, with enterprise accounts needing to enable it in settings.
practices.quote: For some businesses and enterprises, you will need to enable the model from Copilot settings.
